summary: Almonty Industries filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing its voluntary delisting from the Australian Securities Exchange (ASX). The company received formal ASX approval for removal under Listing Rule 17.11, with the delisting expected on September 1, 2026. CDIs will be suspended and cease trading on August 28, 2026. The decision follows a similar delisting from the Toronto Stock Exchange, effective July 31, 2026, driven by low trading volumes (only 0.80% of shares held on the Australian register) and cost reduction. Shares will continue trading on Nasdaq and Frankfurt. A voluntary sale facility opens September 8, 2026, with a compulsory facility starting November 9, 2026. Watch for shareholder conversion and sale timelines.
